info.title: Live (V3)
info.description: Live (V3) API for managing live streaming encoders

bearerAuth.description: OAuth access token of the consumer

get.description: Retrieve a list of live encoders from your account

region.description: AWS region where the encoder will be deployed

event_profile_id.description: HLS profile ID for the encoder output. Available profiles: CMAF 1080p @ 30fps (70e05a7a-f5e4-4a5b-9e4d-c0b9c5d9056c), CMAF 720p @ 30fps (e201c104-c58d-4fcd-bb29-cca4cb46803a), CMAF 1080p @ 60fps (e1deb531-fb06-464f-b859-4ecec656ee6b), CMAF 720p @ 60fps (4356814e-aa38-4e0b-b1bb-0bc9b824de35)

mqcs_input_switch_enabled.description: When enabled, MediaPackage automatically switches to the input presenting the best Media Quality Confidence Score (MQCS).

high_availability_enabled.description: When enabled, provisions a secondary input source for failover. Requires secondary_hostname on push inputs (e.g. RTMP) or source_secondary_url on HLS pull inputs. Also requires backup_url on any RTMP destinations.

nielsen_tagging.description: When enabled, Nielsen PCM-to-ID3 tagging is activated for DAR measurement.

nielsen_distributor_id.description: Nielsen distributor ID for DAR measurement. Only used when nielsen_tagging is enabled.

live_inputs_attributes.description: List of live inputs for the encoder

protocol.description: Protocol for the live input (required on create)

ip_whitelist.description: List of IP addresses/CIDR blocks allowed to stream (1-2 entries required)

hostname.description: Hostname for the live input (1-63 characters, alphanumeric and hyphens only)

source_secondary_url.description: Secondary source URL for HA failover (HLS pull inputs only). Required when high_availability_enabled is true.

live_destinations_attributes.description: List of live destinations for the encoder

start_over_window.description: DVR window duration in seconds (HLS only, 10800-1209600)

playlist_window_duration.description: Live playlist window duration in seconds (HLS only, 0-10800)

stream_key.description: Stream key for the RTMP destination (RTMP only)

primary_url.description: Primary RTMP URL for streaming (RTMP only, required)

backup_url.description: Backup RTMP URL for failover (RTMP only). Required when high_availability_enabled is true on the encoder.

region.description: AWS region where the encoder is deployed

event_profile_id.description: HLS profile ID for the encoder output

mqcs_input_switch_enabled.description: Whether MediaPackage input switching based on Media Quality Confidence Score (MQCS) is enabled for this encoder.

high_availability_enabled.description: Whether High Availability failover is enabled for this encoder.

nielsen_tagging.description: Whether Nielsen PCM-to-ID3 tagging is enabled for this encoder.

nielsen_distributor_id.description: Nielsen distributor ID used for DAR measurement. Only relevant when nielsen_tagging is enabled.

encoder_secondary_url.description: Secondary input URL for failover when High Availability is enabled. Empty string when HA is not enabled.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the encoder was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the encoder was last updated

live_inputs.description: List of live inputs for the encoder

protocol.description: Protocol used for the live input

external_id.description: External identifier from the streaming provider

duration.description: Duration of the live stream in seconds

stream_key.description: Stream key for the RTMP destination

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific live encoder

event_profile_id.description: HLS profile ID for the encoder output. Available profiles: CMAF 1080p @ 30fps (70e05a7a-f5e4-4a5b-9e4d-c0b9c5d9056c), CMAF 720p @ 30fps (e201c104-c58d-4fcd-bb29-cca4cb46803a), CMAF 1080p @ 60fps (e1deb531-fb06-464f-b859-4ecec656ee6b), CMAF 720p @ 60fps (4356814e-aa38-4e0b-b1bb-0bc9b824de35)

mqcs_input_switch_enabled.description: When enabled, MediaPackage automatically switches to the input presenting the best Media Quality Confidence Score (MQCS).

high_availability_enabled.description: When enabled, provisions a secondary input source for failover. Cannot be changed while the encoder is on-air (returns 422 if attempted). Requires secondary_hostname on push inputs (e.g. RTMP) or source_secondary_url on HLS pull inputs. Also requires backup_url on any RTMP destinations.

nielsen_tagging.description: When enabled, Nielsen PCM-to-ID3 tagging is activated for DAR measurement. Cannot be changed while the encoder is on-air.

nielsen_distributor_id.description: Nielsen distributor ID for DAR measurement. Only used when nielsen_tagging is enabled. Cannot be changed while the encoder is on-air.

live_inputs_attributes.description: List of live inputs to update

_id.description: ID of the live input to update

_destroy.description: Set to true to delete this live input

ip_whitelist.description: List of IP addresses/CIDR blocks allowed to stream (1-2 entries required)

hostname.description: Hostname for the live input (1-63 characters, alphanumeric and hyphens only)

source_secondary_url.description: Secondary source URL for HA failover (HLS pull inputs only). Required when high_availability_enabled is true.

live_destinations_attributes.description: List of live destinations to create orupdate

_id.description: ID of the live destination to update (if not provided, a new destination will be created)

_destroy.description: Set to true to delete this live destination

destination_type.description: Type of destination (required when creating a new destination)

start_over_window.description: DVR window duration in seconds (HLS only, 10800-1209600)

playlist_window_duration.description: Live playlist window duration in seconds (HLS only, 0-10800)

stream_key.description: Stream key for the RTMP destination (RTMP only)

primary_url.description: Primary RTMP URL for streaming (RTMP only)

backup_url.description: Backup RTMP URL for failover (RTMP only). Required when high_availability_enabled is true on the encoder.

rtmp_external_profile_id.description: External profile ID for RTMP destination (RTMP only)

422.description: Unprocessable entity - validation errors or hostname taken

post.description: Start broadcasting with a live encoder. This will schedule the RTMP input to the timeline, publish the draft schedule, and start the encoder.

422.description: Unprocessable entity - encoder already started or other error

post.description: Stop broadcasting with a live encoder

422.description: Unprocessable entity - encoder not running or other error

post.description: Synchronize the encoder data with the external streaming provider. This fetches the latest encoder state and updates the local configuration.

parameters.name: encoder_id
parameters.description: Filter by the ID of the encoder. Example: `encoder_id=5992f328ce593000ef000008`

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Filter by the type of event (`linear`, `on-demand`)

parameters.name: created_at
parameters.description: Filter records by created date using times in ISO8601 format (Example: `2017-01-01T00:00:00-00:00`) or Unix timestamps (Example: `1483228800`) **Note**: Range filters can be applied by adding a suffix: ‘.gt’, ‘.gte’, ‘.lt’, ‘lte’ (Example: `created_at.gte`)

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter by active, inactive, or all.  If excluded, query will default to 'true'

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Filter by ascending or descending order

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return, with per_page dictating page size

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of records to return per page

title.description: Give your event a descriptive title

event_type.description: Must be one of `linear` or `on-demand`. `linear` events have a sliding DVR window and are recommended for 24/7 events. `on-demand` events have a fixed DVR window and are recommended for scheduled events.

on_air_at.description: The date and time the event will begin broadcasting. If you do not include a time, then you will need to start the event yourself.

off_air_at.description: The date and time the event will end. If you do not include a time, then you will need to end the event yourself.

subscription_required.description: Determines if your event requires a subscription to view.

pass_required.description: Determines if your event requires a pass to view.

purchase_required.description: Determines if your event must be purchased to view.

rental_required.description: Determines if your event must be rented to view.

rental_duration.description: Number of days your event can be rented.

encoder_id.description: The id of the encoder that should be used to broadcast your event.

auto_archive.description: Determines if your event should automatically be archived once the event ends. You can archive your event as well using the `archive` endpoint.

auto_manage_encoder.description: Determines if you will manage your encoder (turn it on/off) and or if Zype will manage your encoders.

put.description: Use this endpoint to start broadcasting your live event.
Use this endpoint to end broadcasting your live event.
Use this endpoint to archive your live event. Only perform this action once your event has ended.
